description:
General settings tab within the runner Settings panel. Displays application-level preferences for startup behavior and workflow builder defaults. Contains two sections: 'Application' (Auto-load Last Configuration on Startup, Launch on System Startup) and 'Workflow Builder' (Include AI Summary in New Workflows). All three settings are boolean toggle switches that persist via Tauri IPC commands. Toggling uses optimistic UI updates with rollback on failure. The Launch on System Startup toggle is backed by the OS autostart mechanism (Windows Registry Run key, macOS LaunchAgent, Linux .desktop) and reconciles against the actual OS state after each toggle.

groups.description: All three settings are stored in the runner's settings.json file at {config_dir}/com.qontinui.runner/settings.json. Settings are loaded asynchronously on mount via three independent Tauri IPC calls. Each setting persists independently — there is no batch Save button. Changes take effect immediately after the toggle click resolves.
